    # Group by row number

    row_groups = OrderedDict()
    for row in rows:

            col = ''.join(c for c in cell_ref if c.isalpha())
            if row_num not in row_groups:

    lines.append("-" * len(header.expandtabs()))
    for rn, cols in row_groups.items():
